tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page ground for every screen, the nav bar tint and the phone frame. Text: `ink` 15.4:1, `ink-soft` 5.1:1, `ink-faint` 4.6:1.

tokens.name: cream-100
tokens.usage: Quiet fill: sheet row icon discs, empty 'add a look' tiles, dashed placeholders.

tokens.name: cream-200
tokens.usage: Action discs (Capture · Describe · Pick), the cream close button, small pill chips and image wells behind photos. `ink` 13.5:1 on it; `ink-soft` 4.4:1 — use it here for icons and 9px labels only beside, not on, the disc.

tokens.name: cream-300
tokens.usage: Stacked-photo backs and deeper wells under imagery.

tokens.name: cream-400
tokens.usage: Sheet grab handle and dashed borders on empty tiles.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on cream: piece lists, cards, the + discs, id chips.

tokens.name: warm-100
tokens.usage: The selected / today cell in the week strip, marks on a selected day, and the fill of context chips (place · weather) in the DraftLook prompt.

tokens.name: warm-line
tokens.usage: 1px border on the today cell, context chips (place · weather) and changed rows; dashed on the DraftLook add-pieces slot.

tokens.name: warm-past
tokens.usage: Worn-day marks on past days in the week strip.

tokens.name: warm-dash
tokens.usage: 1px dashed border on a piece that is still to find (shop) rather than owned.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, the wordmark, the primary pill fill and the active tab underline. On `cream` 15.4:1.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text, uppercase labels, inactive dock items, icons in discs. On `cream` 5.1:1, `white` 5.4:1.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Meta lines, top-nav links, the weather strip and chevrons. On `cream` 4.6:1, `white` 4.9:1.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers: nav bottom, tab rail, section heads, sheet rows.

tokens.name: rule-mid
tokens.usage: Card and list borders (0.5px) and the phone frame (1px).

tokens.name: ink-line
tokens.usage: 1px border on the outlined 'Add a date' pill in WornView.

tokens.name: mauve
tokens.usage: Base of the rose tints; a soft swatch, never text.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Eyebrows (OOTD, sheet eyebrows), brand names in piece rows, the nav alert dot. Darkened from the Robes stylesheet's #8e7077 to meet contrast: 4.7:1 on `cream`, and white text on it 4.9:1 (the selected filter chip).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Earthy accent for ownership and sage chips. Darkened from the Robes stylesheet's #7e7c5a for legibility: on `cream` 4.6:1, on `white` 4.8:1 (text OK at any size); on `cream-200` 4.0:1, so use it there only at 24px+ or as a fill.

tokens.name: rose-bg
tokens.usage: Faint rose wash behind a rose chip or highlight.

tokens.name: rose-mid
tokens.usage: Stronger rose fill: hover on rose chips.

tokens.name: sage-bg
tokens.usage: Avatar hover ring and sage chip wash.

tokens.name: sage-mid
tokens.usage: Avatar disc fill; `ink` initial on it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Swipe-to-delete reveal, with white 12px label (5.0:1).

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: The single unread dot on a dock item. Never text.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Blurred dark disc over photos (the done tick), and modal backdrops.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind a drawer, such as the DraftLook sheet, and the model sheet.

tokens.name: backdrop-strong
tokens.usage: Dims a drawer behind a confirm dialog (Discard this draft?).

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Cream glass discs over photography (swap, back).

tokens.name: veil-soft
tokens.usage: Light glass discs on a look photo — the back chevron and the adjust-image button on SavedLook, with `blur-disc`. Glyphs on it are `ink`.

tokens.name: veil-paper
tokens.usage: The dashed 'add' card at the back of the image-stack badge.

tokens.name: veil-mid
tokens.usage: The remove-image disc on photo cards in ImageManager.

tokens.name: ink-mute
tokens.usage: The × glyph on the `veil-mid` remove-image disc.

tokens.name: nav-glass
tokens.usage: Top nav background, with 16px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: dock-glass
tokens.usage: Bottom dock background, with 22px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: dock-line
tokens.usage: 1px dock border.

tokens.name: band-glass
tokens.usage: Frosted warm band behind the Lookbook and Wardrobe header (segments, filter chips). Pair with blur-band; it runs up under a glass TopNav.

tokens.name: sheet-glass
tokens.usage: Glass action sheets (New look, Add pieces). Pair with blur-sheet and saturate 180%; inset 8px from the screen edges over a 0.32 ink backdrop.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on desktop. Pair with an `italic-aside` clause in `ink-soft`.

styles.name: greeting
styles.usage: The home greeting on mobile — one per screen.

styles.name: italic-aside
styles.usage: The softer second clause after a heading; captions. Never below 15px.

styles.name: piece-name
styles.usage: Garment names in piece rows. Serif floor — do not set Cormorant smaller.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Split out from the home screen for iteration.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Meta lines, captions under looks, links with a hairline underline.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows above titles, in `rose` or `ink-soft`.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase button, tab and disc labels (0.16em under discs).

styles.name: category
styles.usage: Uppercase category · brand line above a piece name.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label nudges, dock item gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps in meta lines and the weather strip.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap in piece rows, disc to label, list stack gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Space under the greeting, tab body offset.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter inside the phone; sheet side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap; mobile nav side padding; the shell gutter under 768px.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between frames / columns on desktop.

tokens.name: shell-gutter
tokens.usage: Desktop shell side padding (64px <1200, 40px <1024, 24px <768).

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: Top nav height at every breakpoint.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for any control.

tokens.name: rad-xs
tokens.usage: Stacked photo thumbnails and tab underline caps.

tokens.name: rad-row
tokens.usage: Worn-date rows in WornView.

tokens.name: rad-tile
tokens.usage: Look tiles in carousels.

tokens.name: rad-sm
tokens.usage: Week-strip day cells.

tokens.name: rad-thumb
tokens.usage: Model cards in ModelPicker (96 × 120).

tokens.name: rad
tokens.usage: Lists, cards and inputs.

tokens.name: rad-card
tokens.usage: Larger cards.

tokens.name: rad-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners) and floating sheets.

tokens.name: rad-dock
tokens.usage: The bottom dock.

tokens.name: rad-device
tokens.usage: Phone frames in presentation canvases.

tokens.name: rad-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, id chips — every pill.

tokens.usage: Action discs sitting over the photo edge.

tokens.usage: The home screen's ink Create disc, raised between its cream neighbours.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet

tokens.name: shadow-device

tokens.usage: Backdrop blur under the top nav.

tokens.name: blur-dock
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur under the dock.

tokens.usage: Backdrop blur (with saturate 180%) for the band-glass collection header.
